europe_now.title: Russian Drone Attack Damages Cargo Ship in Gulf of Finland
europe_now.summary: A Russia-bound cargo ship was damaged and set ablaze following a drone attack in the Gulf of Finland. Both Finnish and Russian authorities acknowledged the incident amid heightened regional tensions.

europe_now.title: Denmark Accuses Russia of Assassination Plot
europe_now.summary: Denmark has accused Russia of plotting to assassinate a US-Ukrainian rapper and subsequently expelled a Russian diplomat. European Commission leadership condemned the alleged plot as an unacceptable escalation of hostile activities.

top_stories.title: European Union Budget Proposals and Cuts
top_stories.summary: The European Union faces internal debates as proposed budget cuts of ten percent pit different member state factions against each other. Officials are discussing strategic reductions ahead of an upcoming summit.

top_stories.title: Ongoing Social Unrest and Protests in France
top_stories.summary: France experiences its sixth consecutive week of demonstrations and public protests regarding economic and security policies. Although turnout has shown signs of decreasing, widespread civil mobilization continues across the country.
